headline: Did CMS’s Renewables Exit and Regulated Pivot Just Shift CMS Energy's (CMS) Investment Narrative?
summary: In the past week, CMS Energy Corporation reported second-quarter 2026 results showing sales of US$1,829 million and net income of US$120 million, while reaffirming full-year guidance and announcing plans to exit its non-utility renewable development business to refocus US$1.70 billion of capital on regulated utility operations. headline: CMS Energy (CMS) Exits Renewable Development, Is The Stock Still Cheap?
